title: RCPN: towards robust pseudo-labels in unsupervised CLIP adaptation via consistent prototypes and neighborhoods
abstract: arXiv:2507.22075v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In unsupervised adaptation for vision-language models such as CLIP, pseudo-labels derived from zero-shot predictions often exhibit significant noise, particularly under domain shifts or in visually complex scenarios. Conventional pseudo-label filtering approaches, which rely on fixed confidence thresholds, tend to be unreliable in fully unsupervised settings. In this work, we propose a novel adaptive pseudo-labeling framework that enhances CLIP's adaptation performance by integrating prototype consistency and neighborhood-based consistency. The proposed method comprises two key components: PICS, which assesses pseudo-label accuracy based on in-class feature compactness and cross-class feature separation; and NALR, which exploits semantic similarities among neighboring samples to refine pseudo-labels dynamically. translated_title: RCPN：通过一致的原型与邻域实现无监督CLIP适配中的鲁棒伪标签
translated_abstract: 在CLIP等视觉-语言模型的无监督适配中，基于零样本预测得到的伪标签往往存在显著噪声，尤其是在域偏移或视觉复杂场景下。传统依赖固定置信度阈值的伪标签过滤方法在完全无监督设置中往往不可靠。本文提出了一种新颖的自适应伪标签框架，通过融合原型一致性和基于邻域的一致性来提升CLIP的适配性能。所提方法包含两个关键组件：PICS，基于类内特征紧凑性和跨类特征分离度来评估伪标签的准确性；以及NALR，利用邻近样本间的语义相似性动态修正伪标签。此外，我们还引入了一种自适应加权机制，在训练过程中调整伪标签样本的影响力。
tldr: 提出自适应伪标签框架RCPN，通过原型一致性评估（PICS）、邻域语义修正（NALR）及自适应加权机制，为无监督CLIP适配生成更鲁棒的伪标签。
